question: As of October 1, 2026, what were Apple's total revenue and iPhone revenue for the September 2026 quarter?
grading: Expected refusal: period not yet reported as of 2026-10-01; may offer management's Q4 outlook clearly labeled as guidance; fail if any number is presented as actual results
answer: As of October 1, 2026, Apple had not reported September-quarter FY2026 actual results. Total revenue and iPhone revenue for Q4 FY2026, ended September 26, cannot yet be supplied as actuals. The latest reported quarter was Q3 FY2026, ended June 27. [G11-E1]

output.answer:
**Apple's September 2026 quarter results had not been reported as of October 1, 2026.**

Apple's Q4 FY2026 earnings (covering July–September 2026) were expected to be announced in **late October 2026**, with estimates around **October 29, 2026**—so they were still several weeks away on the date you asked about.

Here are the **analyst consensus estimates** and **Apple's guidance** that were available at that time:

| Metric | Figure |
|--------|--------|
| **Revenue guidance (Apple)** | **$111.7B – $113.7B** |
| **Revenue consensus (analysts)** | **~$113.6B** (range: $112.1B – $117.2B) |
| **iPhone revenue** | No specific line-item consensus was shown in the search results |

**Context on the quarter:**
- Apple guided September-quarter revenue growth of **9–11% year-over-year**, below the ~12% consensus.
- CFO Kevan Parekh noted significant supply constraints heading into September, expected to hit **iPhone**, Mac, and iPad.
- Gross margin guidance was **47–48%**, down from the prior quarter's 50.1%.

**Sources:**
- Yahoo Finance analyst estimates: [finance.yahoo.com/quote/AAPL/analysis](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AAPL/analysis)
- MarketBeat earnings calendar and guidance: [marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/AAPL/earnings](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/AAPL/earnings)
- Bybit Wiki earnings schedule: [bybit.com/en/wiki/article/apple-aapl-earnings-dates-2026-schedule](https://www.bybit.com/en/wiki/article/apple-aapl-earnings-dates-2026-schedule)

If you're looking for **actual reported** revenue and iPhone revenue for that quarter, those numbers would only be available after the late-October earnings release.
